arya: Heads up — onboarding a HF model and hitting special-token ID drift after hf->redwood conversion + quantize. Outputs sometimes cut off mid-chat (looks like EOS/ PAD mismatch). repro below.

arya: Quick repro I used locally:
```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('path/to/hf-model')
print('special_tokens_map', t.special_tokens_map)
print('added_tokens', t.added_tokens_encoder)
print('first ids', t.encode('Hello')[:10])
```
Then run our rwd-convert + quantize pipeline and you get different ids for <pad> / <unk> vs HF. Example diff: HF: unk=100, pad=1, bos=0  -> Redwood-converted: unk=3, pad=100, bos=0.

sam: Oof. Which converter version? rwd-convert v0.9 or the newer internal script? Also which tokenizer format (tokenizer.json vs files)? :eyes:

arya: Using internal rwd-convert 1.2.0 (the one pipeline uses). Tokenizer artifacts included: tokenizer.json + added_tokens.json (added_tokens.json entries don't have explicit ids). config.json includes 'bos_token': '<s>', 'eos_token': '</s>' and HF left added_tokens as list without ids.

marta: Seen this before — when added_tokens.json has no ids HF assigns ids at vocab end, and our converter currently reindexes the whole vocab instead of preserving original ids. That causes special tokens to shift. cc @tomas for the converter logic.

tomas: I can repro locally with your model. The converter appends added tokens and then regenerates vocab -> bad. Proposed fix: preserve original token-id mapping if present, and when added_tokens lack explicit ids, compute HF's assigned ids and record them in the converted tokenizer metadata. Patch idea: populate 'added_tokens' with explicit 'ids' during conversion and skip global reindex.

luis: This also explains the eval regression we saw — quantized run had BLEU/chrF drops and chat eval shows missing EOS during sampling. KV cache indexing relies on stable token ids, so remapping breaks cache lookups. We observed ~2.1 BLEU drop on our small chat eval set. We should add an onboarding check for token-id stability before quantize.

marta: +1 on adding a unit test and a gating eval step. Can you paste the minimal diff output you see? I'll update the onboarding checklist.

arya: Minimal diff (excerpt):
```
HF vocab slice: ['<s>':0, '</s>':1, '<pad>':2, '<unk>':100]
After convert: ['<s>':0, '</s>':1, '<unk>':3, '<pad>':100]
Converter log: appended 4 added tokens -> new vocab_size=50256
```
Note: added_tokens.json had no ids, HF gave them ids 100..103 but converter shoved them to 50000+ and rebalanced.

tomas: I'm opening PR rwd/converter#432 to: 1) compute HF assigned ids for added tokens when missing, 2) emit a warning and fail-fast on special-token id shifts, 3) add test fixtures for tokenizer.json + added_tokens.json combos. Test plan: run conversion + quantize on our 10-model smoke matrix and run eval harness. ETA EOD.

redwood-ci: Build succeeded for branch converter-fix-keep-ids, 128 tests passed.

arya: Thanks — I'll rerun the quantized evals overnight and report results tomorrow AM. If this fixes it we should backfill a migration note and rerun previously failed conversions. :thumbsup:
